_comment: Copy to config/local.json (git-ignored) only if auto-detection fails. Use your own paths. Never commit secrets.

_environment.SM_GAME_DIR: The game install (the folder holding data). Overrides gameDir below. Read-only, never written.
_environment.SM_DATA_DIR: The private data and cache root. Default: %LOCALAPPDATA%/sm-reimpl on Windows, ~/.local/share/sm-reimpl on Linux. Must lie outside SM_GAME_DIR.
_environment.SM_STEAM_DIR: Replaces the Steam lookup when finding the install (tests; empty = no Steam folder).
